title: AI Grid: Engines and EPP
description: vLLM engines (vllm-vcr) and the llm-d endpoint picker: latency, throughput, queueing, KV cache, scheduling.

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (cluster, model_name, le) (rate(vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", model_name=~"$model"}[5m])))
